design_notes.fix_vs_826: 826's _run_phase never called agent._e1_tick(latent) (the tick dict from agent.clock.advance() was discarded), so _world_experience_buffer never reached compute_prediction_loss()'s length>=2 floor and E1 trained on a permanent zero-gradient stub for the whole run. This script captures the latent and the ticks dict and calls agent._e1_tick(latent) when ticks.get('e1_tick', False) -- the same gate act()/act_with_split_obs() use -- and nothing else. Per-phase n_e1_ticks is recorded on every row for audit (failure_autopsy_batch-822a-826-817a-827_2026-07-26.md section 1).

config.fix_vs_826: calls agent._e1_tick(latent) on e1_tick cadence; no other change
